release.label: Firmware
install.title: Choose your device. Connect it.
install.description: The four builds share every feature. They differ in the board (CYD / E32R28T: amplifier, RGB LED and light sensor wiring) and the display controller (ILI9341 / ST7789). The browser cannot tell them apart; choose what you have.
model.compatibility: For this project’s classic ESP32 / 4 MB / 320×240 / XPT2046 pin configuration only. Not every board with the same display name is compatible.
model.wiringText: LCD: CLK 14 · MOSI 13 · DC 2 · CS 15 · BL 21. Touch: CLK 25 · MOSI 32 · MISO 39 · CS 33 · IRQ 36.
model.validation: All four v3.1.1 builds compile and pass the package checks; CYD · ILI9341 and E32R28T · ST7789 were tested on hardware. Not for ESP32-S3 / C3 or other resolutions.
browser.unsupported: This browser cannot reach a serial port. Use desktop Chrome / Edge or Chrome on Android, or download the firmware and flash it manually.
browser.insecure: Open this page over HTTPS or localhost.
connect.title: Connect your CYD
connect.description: Connect with a USB data cable. Close Thonny, serial monitors and any other application using the serial port.
connect.permission: Your browser will ask you to select a USB serial port. Writing only starts after you confirm installation.
verify.idle: Firmware files will be checked after selection
data.title: Back up your original program and recovery information.
data.description: Flashing replaces the original program. “Erase device” also clears Wi-Fi, settings and MFA accounts. When moving from MicroPython or another firmware, back up first and select erase. CWBSM upgrades with the same partition layout can keep erase unchecked.
setup.title: Three steps to make it yours.
setup.description: CWBSM uses its own setup access point, rather than the Wi-Fi configuration in the flashing dialog.
setup.reset: Wait for the display to turn on. If needed, press RESET / EN or unplug and reconnect USB.
setup.wifi: On first boot, connect to CWBSM-setup. Supported phones open the setup page automatically; you can also scan the screen’s QR code.
setup.configure: Save your home Wi-Fi details. The device restarts and connects to your router. Then open the IP address shown in its status bar.
setup.retained: An upgrade that retains saved Wi-Fi settings may reconnect directly without creating a setup hotspot.
downloads.title: Manual firmware packages
downloads.note: Four images, flash addresses and SHA-256 checksums
downloads.details: Show selected firmware files and checksums
downloads.select: Select a device to see details.
faq.title: Need a hand?
faq.browserA: Desktop Chrome or Edge is recommended. This page checks for Web Serial; manual downloads remain available without it. HTTPS or localhost / 127.0.0.1 is required. Double-clicking the HTML file, ordinary LAN HTTP and mobile browsers usually cannot complete this workflow.
faq.portQ: No device in the serial port list?
faq.portA: Check that your USB cable supports data, try another USB port, and close Thonny, Arduino serial monitors and other flashing pages. Install the USB-to-serial driver recommended by your board manufacturer if needed.
faq.bootA: Try holding BOOT, then pressing EN / RESET. Release BOOT after connection. Keep the cable connected, the page open and your computer awake during installation.
faq.modelQ: Not sure which screen you have?
faq.modelA: Check your purchase listing, PCB markings or original display driver. CYD branding, USB connector count and appearance alone are not reliable. A wrong driver may produce a blank screen, incorrect colors or offsets. Verify the pin connections before choosing.
faq.eraseA: For CWBSM v1.5 upgrades, leave Erase device unchecked to retain NVS settings. This installs a new partition table: 3.75 MiB app, 128 KiB filesystem. Back up before erasing; erasing removes Wi-Fi, settings and MFA.
faq.mfaQ: Can I store important MFA accounts?
faq.mfaA: This is community preview firmware. MFA has a PIN and encrypted storage, but no secure element, flash encryption or secure boot. A lost device remains exposed to offline attacks. Keep recovery codes and avoid using it as the only authenticator for critical accounts.
environment.unsupported: This browser cannot flash over serial. Use desktop Chrome / Edge, Chrome on Android, or download the firmware.
upstream.hint: The ESP Web Tools dialog may show English button labels. Follow the translated installation steps in the guide.
